arguments.code:
# Post question about last t-shirt ordered on amazon
# Assumes amazon_token and orders_all from prior steps.
print('amazon_token in globals:', 'amazon_token' in globals())
print('orders_all in globals:', 'orders_all' in globals())

question_text = "Has anyone experienced the color fade after the first wash?"

# find last t-shirt item by created_at among order_items whose name indicates t-shirt
last=None
for o in orders_all:
    created_at = o.get('created_at')
    if not created_at:
        continue
    for item in o.get('order_items',[]):
        name = (item.get('product_name') or '').lower()
        if 't-shirt' in name or 't shirt' in name or 'tshirt' in name:
            pid = item.get('product_id')
            if pid is None:
                continue
            # use lexicographic compare for ISO timestamps
            key = created_at
            if last is None or key > last['created_at']:
                last = {
                    'created_at': created_at,
                    'order_id': o.get('order_id'),
                    'product_id': pid,
                    'product_name': item.get('product_name')
                }

print('selected_last_tshirt:', last)

resp = apis.amazon.write_product_question(product_id=last['product_id'], question=question_text, access_token=amazon_token)
print(resp)
